messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate check-in

Hi Alex — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Current pilot goals: evaluate LLM-based triage and summarization for provider notes, integrate via API into your staging environment.
- You mentioned target latency of <300ms median for inference and ~99th pct SLA for peak traffic.
- Pilot timeline: 4 weeks with an initial credit pool to validate integration and basic throughput.

To help us size pricing and any credits extension: can you confirm the current token burn rate you saw during the PoC? Specific asks: average tokens/day, peak tokens/day, and expected ramp over the next 30 days. Also let me know if there is a hard budget cap for the pilot (ballpark $/month) or a target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for.

If useful, I attached a one-page scope that maps flows -> token estimates.

Next steps:
1) You share burn-rate numbers + budget range
2) We propose either an extension of free credits or a modest pilot rate depending on your budget and forecast
3) Schedule a 15-min check-in next week to align on integration items

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

[Attachment: pilot_scope.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) - 42KB]

Best,

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot credits / burn-rate check-in

Hey Marissa — thanks for the recap. Quick answers below based on the first week of the pilot: 

- Avg tokens/day (current): ~120,000 tokens/day (mostly generation for summaries, some embeddings for similarity search)
- Peak observed: ~350,000 tokens in a heavy processing run (batch overnight)
- Forecast: we expect to ramp to ~300-400k tokens/day over next 2-3 weeks as more provider workflows are routed into the pipeline
- Budget for pilot: we have a tight pilot budget right now, roughly $1,500-2,000/month. For the broader program we can discuss higher figures, but for the pilot we need to stay within that range.
- Target $/1M tokens: we were hoping to see a rate around $800-1,200 / 1M tokens for generation; embeddings separately are ok at the standard rate if you can share that.

Given the ramp, we might exhaust the initial credits by mid-Feb unless we get an extension. Can you advise what you can offer? Also looped in procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) for approvals.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Jones
Director of ML Engineering, Acme Health
alex.jones@acmehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits / burn-rate check-in — request for extension approval

Team — forwarding Acme's burn-rate and budget. Short ask: they need more credits to continue validating the integration; pilot is showing strong signal and reasonable chance to expand post-pilot. Proposed concession: extend free credits by 1,000,000 tokens and +30 days on pilot window.

Why I recommend this:
- They are showing steady ramp (120k -> projected 300-400k/day) which indicates genuine usage and quick evidence gathering.
- Budget is tight now ($1.5k-2k/mo). If we push a small extension we keep momentum and capture a larger commitment this quarter.

- This is connected to deal ACME-2345 (sales cycle target Q2).

Attachments: pilot_summary.pdf (one-pager with usage metrics).

Can you approve this extension? If we need to be more conservative, what is your recommended token amount and any guardrails (e.g., limited to non-production endpoints, metrics check-in)?

Thanks,
Marissa
[Attachment: pilot_summary.pdf (application/pdf) - 120KB]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credits / burn-rate check-in — request for extension approval

Marissa — thanks for the note and the data. Approve, but recommend increasing to 1.5M free tokens for this pilot given the projected ramp and to avoid a mid-week cutoff. Conditions:

- Extension: +1,500,000 tokens applied to the existing pilot account
- Duration: +30 days from today (2027-03-12 check-in)
- Guardrails: credits valid for non-production/staging only; we require a short check-in at 2 weeks to confirm burn aligns with the plan.
- Ask Marissa to capture acceptance from Alex/procurement with an email confirming scope and that they understand the guardrails.

I also want this tied to the HubSpot deal ACME-2345 and a brief SOW note in the deal record. Vivek — loop in if you want different limits.

Rishi
Director, Sales Operations
[Internal note added: extension_approval.txt]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com

Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot credits extension approved — next steps

Hi Alex / procurement — good news: we've approved a pilot extension. Summary below and next steps.

- What we approved: 1,500,000 free tokens (applied to your existing pilot account) and a 30-day extension to the pilot window.
- Conditions: credits are for staging/non-production validation only; we'll do a brief check-in in ~2 weeks to confirm burn and results.
- Timeline: extension takes effect immediately; credits should appear in your account within the hour.
- Acceptance: please reply to confirm you accept the guardrails above. Procurement — if you need a short confirmation note or SOW line for records we can produce one.

Next steps:
1) Alex — confirm you accept the guardrails in a reply to this thread.
2) Marissa to schedule a 15-min check-in for 2027-02-24 to review integration and burn.
3) If the pilot shows the expected signal we will propose a commercial pilot rate aligned to your $/1M target; we have flexibility around $800-1,200/1M tokens depending on volumes and commitment.
